name: Student List (Studentska lista) economic plan
detail: November 2026 plan: property tax counted progressively over all real estate a person owns, a levy on flats empty over 12 months and higher rates on large inheritances; the list says the aim is to make evasion harder, not to raise revenue. Property and inheritance taxes only; no tax on net wealth.

name: Ne davimo Beograd / Zeleno-levi klub extra-profit tax bill (Dec 2022)
detail: One-off crisis tax on companies extra profit and a family-home relief in the property tax: a windfall and property tax.

name: Zakon o utvrđivanju porekla imovine i posebnom porezu (asset-origin law)
detail: Special tax on property whose origin cannot be shown (bill 3199-19; discussed by the Green-Left Front in 2025): a tax on unexplained income, not on net wealth.

name: Godišnji porez na dohodak građana (porez na bogate)
detail: Serbia annual income tax on high earners (10% and 15% above 3 and 6 average salaries) is called porez na bogate in the press; it taxes income, not wealth.

name: Narodna stranka (Đorđe Stanković) multiple-property tax
detail: Progressive rates on owning a second, third and further property: a property tax.

name: Miodrag Zec
detail: Says Serbia lacks an adequate tax on property, income and inheritance, especially for large wealth; no call for a net wealth tax seen on a page opened.

name: Branko Milanović
detail: Backs the Zucman tax as a pedagogical tax (H-Alter, Croatia), but no statement made in or to Serbia was found; see leads.
